cause_quote: The new resolveAuthorizedDreamingSidecar set `selectedMemoryPluginId = normalizeLowercaseStringOrEmpty(params.memorySlot)` and then required `params.manifestRegistry.plugins.find((plugin) => plugin.id === selectedMemoryPluginId)`, replacing the earlier `pluginId !== dreamingEngineId` exemption, so a mixed-case memory plugin ID no longer matched its manifest and the sidecar was not authorized.
user_saw: With a selected memory plugin whose declared ID has mixed case, recall worked but the bundled dreaming sidecar's intent tool was missing.
summary: Stops lowercasing the selected memory plugin ID in the startup dreaming-plugin planner and in the loader's dreaming sidecar authorization, using the slot normalizer so the declared ID matches its manifest.
reasoning: GraphQL blame at the pre-split loader.ts shows the lowercased manifest lookup came from de1d329e (June 2026, #93678); before it, 5fde14b's resolveDreamingSidecarEngineId only lowercased to compare against "none"/memory-core and the loader exempted memory-core via `pluginId !== dreamingEngineId`, which worked regardless of the selected ID's case. Later refactors (f1fc708f75c, a38b64b2fea5) preserved the lowercasing. Medium because I did not confirm the startup-planner side's history or that mixed-case declared IDs were preserved through slot normalization before June.
